description: This file defines an interface ILogTestGrain used for testing log-consistency providers in a grain-based system, along with a struct AB used for returning combined data.

classes.name: AB
classes.description: A struct used by unit tests to return both A and B values simultaneously.

methods.name: GetAGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves the global value of A.

methods.name: GetALocal
methods.description: Retrieves the local value of A.

methods.name: GetBothGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B globally.

methods.name: GetBothLocal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B locally.

methods.name: GetReservationsGlobal
methods.description: Gets global reservations.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Gets the confirmed version number.

methods.name: SetAGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global value of A.

methods.name: SetAConditional
methods.description: Sets A conditionally based on current state.

methods.name: SetALocal
methods.description: Sets the local value of A.

methods.name: IncrementALocal
methods.description: Increments the local value of A.

methods.name: IncrementAGlobal
methods.description: Increments the global value of A.

methods.name: SetBGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global value of B.

methods.name: SetBLocal
methods.description: Sets the local value of B.

methods.name: AddReservationLocal
methods.description: Adds a local reservation.

methods.name: RemoveReservationLocal
methods.description: Removes a local reservation.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the current state as key-value pairs.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the state with a list of modifications, expecting a specific version.

methods.name: GetEventLog

methods.name: SynchronizeGlobalState
methods.description: Synchronizes the global state.

methods.name: Deactivate
